text: Phase 4 complete. 59 JVM and 61 Scala.js tests pass. Evidence covers scalar/axis/keep/dynamic reductions, empty identities, NaN propagation and first-NaN arg behavior, signed-zero min/max, tie order, fixed pairwise reference parity, layout-independent schedules, legal sumAs pairs, injective mutable view compositions, freeze isolation, no mutable broadcast API, and specialized/callback Into kernels.
